=== Tags ===

Common OSM tags used for roads:

; {{Tag|highway|primary}} : A major road, not a motorway
; {{Tag|highway|secondary}} : A road linking large towns
; {{Tag|highway|path}} : A generic path for pedestrians or cyclists
